_comment: SHARED MARKET RECORDS. One entry per country landing page (/coding-classes-in-<slug>).
Drives the hreflang cluster (scripts/apply-hreflang-cluster.js + verify-hreflang.js) and is
the place to look up how a market is billed and served. Facts only: currency and billing
come from pricing/pricing.config.jsonc (INR inside India, one USD list everywhere else;
group and 1-on-1 plans, 2 live classes a week); the payment route is what the course
pages actually do (Razorpay checkout in India, team-assisted payment over WhatsApp abroad).
Teaching language, support hours and local student evidence are NOT asserted where the
site has no verified fact. Times are stored in UTC by the backend; pages show the
visitor's own timezone via the browser (IANA zone below is the market's main zone).

shared.includedClasses: 2 live classes a week (8 a month)
shared.recordings: Free class recordings first (Google sign-in), live demo optional, direct enrolment available
